svg.text: │i Inspect the cursor's row beside the overview, or stop │
│g a Apply the live column here, leaving plain values │
│g A Write the pitch the mod slots played into the notes │
│r Record notes played in Insert, while playing │
│m Mute or unmute; held, until let go │
│s Solo or unsolo; held, until let go │
│g m Mute or unmute on the launch grid, or take it back │
│g s Solo or unsolo on the launch grid, or take it back │
│l Fill on or off; held, until let go │
│A Realign every track on the launch grid, or take it back│
│a Realign this track on the launch grid, or take it back │
│e Give this track's faders back to the steps' automation │
│E Give every track's faders back to the steps' automation│
